title: Abyssals v0.90.67 — The Pale Gate
notes: Enter the First Circle through the Hell Mirror with Vantis Eldrin. Six winter maps lead through a timed ferry riddle, the Hall of Misfiled Names, two optional missions and the Keeper of Names under Namefog. Beating the Keeper unlocks the Underway Relay. Updates in place with the original Android signing identity. Existing expedition saves and previously created Spindle preview eggs are supported.
